exercises.question: Seldom ________ ever strike in the same place twice.
Not only ________ late, but he also forgot his presentation.
exercises.explanation: "Not only" triggers inversion: auxiliary (did) + subject (he) + verb (arrive).

exercises.question: Under no circumstances ________ leave the exam room early.
exercises.explanation: "Under no circumstances" is a negative fronted adverbial, requiring inversion: should + students.

exercises.question: The company is not doing poorly — ________, profits actually rose last year.
exercises.explanation: "On the contrary" contradicts the previous negative statement and introduces a positive fact.

exercises.template: Not only ___ the report, but she also presented it.
exercises.explanation: Negative inversion: when a negative phrase starts a clause, the verb is inverted.

exercises.title: B2+ Inversion
exercises.question: Correct: 'Rarely ___ such honesty.'
exercises.explanation: Negative adverb at front triggers inversion: do we hear.

exercises.question: Never ________ such a difficult decision before.
exercises.explanation: After 'never' at the start, use inversion: Never have I made.

exercises.question: Only after the meeting ________ the real problem.
exercises.explanation: After 'only after' at the beginning, use auxiliary inversion: did we understand.

exercises.question: Not only ________ late, but he had also forgotten the documents.
exercises.explanation: Use inversion after 'not only' when it begins the sentence: did he arrive.

exercises.question: Under no circumstances ________ this password with anyone.
exercises.explanation: A negative phrase at the start requires inversion: should you share.

exercises.question: Little ________ that the plan would fail.
exercises.explanation: 'Little did they know...' is a fixed emphatic inversion pattern.

exercises.question: So difficult ________ that many students gave up.
exercises.explanation: With 'so + adjective' at the beginning, use inversion: So difficult was the exam...
